deviations.source_anchor: A Walking Calamity Shaman player would miss TWO things: (1) the two-tier Rage->Glory economy -- Rage OVERFLOW at max feeds a SEPARATE Glory meter that, at cap, ACTIVATES the meteor storm; collapsed to one accumulator + threshold-proc, the 'fill Rage, spill into Glory, Glory caps and the sky falls' rhythm reads as a plain charge-then-proc (same WATCH-ITEM deviation as b02 shaman-bear). (2) the ENEMY-COUNT frequency scaling -- meteor cadence ramps up to 200% MORE frequent the more enemies surround you, a density-reactive output curve the engine's ground_targeted_circle + GEOMETRY_PROPAGATION door approximate as generic on-kill cascade rather than a first-class 'more targets -> faster meteors' coupling. The core (a fire meteor-field autobomber that propagates kills via Herald of Ice) maps recognizably, but the two-tier accrual + density-scaling are the deviations -> APPROX (that build, flatter economy + no density ramp); both are steward candidates, not unmodelable, so APPROX not GAPPED.

mapping_json.fidelity_notes: GX-01 GX-17 (corpus gx). HOT-FLAG 1 RESOLVED -- ERRATA-19 CORRECTED IDENTITY mapped: folk_name 'Walking Calamity Shaman'; core_skills [Walking Calamity, Herald of Ice, Polcirkeln]; the pre-errata 'Autobomber/Molten Crash' identity was CONTRADICTED (verify_ledger, errata_applied=1) and is NOT mapped. This kit's Walking Calamity is the ACTIVE-cast Glory-payoff ('Activate it to cause large meteors to constantly rain down for over 20 seconds') -- DISTINCT from b02 poe2-shaman-bear, where Walking Calamity appears as a PASSIVE Glory-cap auto-proc sub-skill of a Bear-Form Rage bruiser. RELATIONSHIP: this (Walking Calamity Shaman) and b02 shaman-bear are the SAME shaman/Druid Rage->Glory->Walking-Calamity FAMILY but plausibly DISTINCT kits -- this one is the meteor-autobomber built AROUND Walking Calamity as the active headline (fire meteors + Herald of Ice/Polcirkeln propagation, NO in-form Bear slams as the identity), whereas shaman-bear is a Bear-Form slam bruiser where Walking Calamity is the tail-end payoff. Filed as 'accrual to the shaman-bear Rage->Glory two-tier-accumulator family' WITHOUT number (steward-counted); the two-tier Rage->Glory row (addendum B) applies -> ONE accumulator + threshold-proc + fidelity_note the Glory second tier. Section-B WATCH-ITEM referenced; instance-counting is steward-owned. Physical-to-fire 100% conversion (Avatar of Evolution) -> ELEMENT_CONVERSION_PHYSICAL is a candidate door but GEOMETRY_PROPAGATION (on-kill meteor+Herald cascade) is the DOMINANT identity per 7.2 -> GEOMETRY_PROPAGATION + MOMENTUM_CASCADE (Rage/Glory ramp) chosen; conversion noted in traits. chain_count=3 per R-M2 (Walking Calamity + Herald of Ice propagation + Rage-builder slams). GX-01/GX-17 corpus flags. eras 0.5-ancients CONFIRMED. [STEWARD AUDIT m03: 'burn' stripped (mapper note says 'burn (fire meteors)' -- element-flavor; fetched text attests fire DAMAGE + physical-to-fire conversion, no burn status); 'freeze' stripped (fetched text attests 'Herald of Ice + Polcirkeln propagates KILLS across packs' -- kill-propagation only; 'freeze-shatter' language was poe1 priors). Propagation identity survives in ring geometry + GEOMETRY_PROPAGATION door. RUN-WIDE no-un-named-status law]

One-button autobomber once active; Rampage for single-target.
